column1: # One row per case, five tab-separated columns — see tests/README.md.
#   fixture   the envelope in fixtures/ the scratch repository is built from, or `-` for a

#             chain's `init` printed, `@file:<name>` a copy of inputs/<name> (see drive.sh)
#   exit      0 answered, 1 a submission refused, 2 called wrong, 3 could not read
#   expect    fragments of the LAST step's answer, compacted to one line, split on `|`
#   note      what the case is there to hold
